description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 26.04.2021 to 02.05.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes a new regulatory framework for currency conversion in customs transactions. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements for international trade.
